newsitem.title: USA: Walgreen June same-store sales up 9.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Walgreen June same-store sales up 9.2 pct.

text.p: Walgreen Co, the drug store operator, said Wednesday that sales in stores open at least a year rose 9.2 percent in June.
Overall sales for the month were $1.09 billion, up from $945.5 million a year ago.
Pharmacy sales were up 22.5 percent overall for the month, while comparable-store pharmacy sales rose 16.5 percent.
Comparable-store sales rose 8.3 percent in the first 10 months of fiscal 1997, the company said. Overall sales for the first 10 months were $11.15 billion, up from $9.81 billion a year ago.
Shares of Walgreen, which operated 2,305 drugstores at June 30, were up 9/16 at 54-7/8 Wednesday.
